question_text: A Python class Reservation has constructor __init__(self, rate, priority=False). Construct two calls: one reservation at rate40 using the default priority, and another at rate40 with priorityTrue. Outline why one constructor supports both.
adaptation_rationale: Replaces Java constructor overloading with accurate Python optional-argument initialization.
solution: a = Reservation(40); b = Reservation(40,True). The optional parameter supplies False when omitted and accepts the caller’s value when supplied.
